description: We are a couple of Computer Science students interested in computer programming and game design, and we are looking for anyone with similar interests! We have no previous hackathon experience but are excited to try it out and learn.
summary: We built an interactive decision-based 2D video game that combines fun with educational material. Its aim is to help children comprehend what NASA really does, especially what astronauts go through in space.
details: The project was build using python3, especially the pygame library. No AI was used in its creation, and we manually typed over 400 lines of code. We tried to combine education and entertainment, while taking the player on a different adventure each time. The game has 32 unique endings, all containing loveable characters, though-out plotlines and showcasing a myriad of emotions. The game implements various fonts, images and sound effects in order to elevate the player's experience.
dataRefs: How to Protect Astronauts from Space Radiation
